verdict.rationale: The docs show financial accounts can be created programmatically through the API (money_manager configuration, the FinancialAccount object), with a financial address for funding and platform-built controls for account onboarding. Nothing in the pack shows the account is an insured deposit account, describes a programmatic path from application through to active status, or mentions a sandbox or test-mode equivalent of the flow. Missing for 10: evidence of deposit insurance, a documented end-to-end programmatic application/KYC-to-active lifecycle, sandbox/test-mode parity for account provisioning, and independent hands-on corroboration.
